7b8(mdo): spyod pa/sprul pa'i yul can/de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis ting nge 'dzin las bslang ba'i sbyor ba/sa brgyad pa las 'das pa/chos kyi sprin gyi sa la shes par rab tu byas pa/sangs rgyas 
8a1(mdo): @#//kyi che ba nyid myong nas de bzhin gshegs pa bdag gi so so rang gis rig pa 'phags pa'i ye shes kyis rtogs pa'i spyod yul gyi sar zhugs te/thams cad du 'gro ba ma g.yos 
8a2(mdo): pa'i ting nge 'dzin spyod pa/lhun gyis grub pa/rtag pa/ther zug pa/brtan pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing stug po na gnas par 'gyur te/rdo rje'i dbang po sa la dbang ba rnams la 'phrul pa'i 'jug pa 
8a3(mdo): ston par 'gyur te/gnas gyur pa/yid bzhin gyi ye shes dang ting nge 'dzin can/stobs dang /mngon par shes pa dang /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang /dbang la spyod pa/dang ba'i rgyal po 
8a4(mdo): dang 'dra bar ma zhugs pa'i chu bo zla ba lta bur 'gro ste/blta ba'i don yod pa/mi'i bdag po thams cad kyi tshogs kyi 'khor du sems can rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta bar 'dod pa'i gzugs dag 
8a5(mdo): gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing stug pa bstan pa'i phyir sems can gyi bsam pa bzhin du 'jug par 'gyur ro//'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang po thams cad dang /dbang sgyur ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems 
8a6(mdo): dpa' chen po nor bu rin po che'i snying po la sogs pa'i gnas dag tu bde ba rnams myong bar byas te sa'i rim pa rnams bstan nas zhing nas zhing du phun sum bde ba rnams rab tu ston cing phyi ma'i 
8a7(mdo): mthar thug par bsku ba grub pa'i sngags 'chang ltar mi snang zhing khang khyim gyi lha ltar de na gnas bzhin du mi snang ba'i gzugs su khyim na 'dug pa ltar de dag sprul pa'i 'od zer dang /'phrul 
8a8(mdo): pas sprul pa la spyod cing 'gro'o//song nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa'i sku nub ste/de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la zhan nas gnas par 'gyur ro//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 
8b1(mdo): tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so//dbang po phung po sprul yin te//sred dang ma rig las kyang yin//bag chags kyis bcings mi bzad pa//yul dang dbang po'i rgyu las byung //rnam dpyod tshogs 
8b2(mdo): ni 'dod chags rnams//zhags pa sems bskyed de yin no//khro ba me lce mnyam pa ste//zhe sdang dug gi dngos po yin//thub spyod rnal 'byor bzang can gyis//'di dag rtag tu rnam gzhigs te//
8b3(mdo): phung po rnams ni dor ba'i phyir//rnal 'byor can gyis rnal 'byor spyod//gzugs ni 'byung ba'i tshogs yin te//phung po lhag ma gzugs med pa//ji bzhin bar snang ri mo dang //grib la sdong dum 
8b4(mdo): la sogs med//mkha' la rlung gzugs mi snang dang //bya yi rjes rnams ji bzhin ni//mkhas pas so so rang rig pa//yang dag nyid dang yang dag mtha'//tshig gi spyod yul 'das pa ni//
8b5(mdo): sangs rgyas dngos po mi snang ste//sangs rgyas sgras ni mya ngan 'das//mya ngan 'das kyang sangs rgyas te//rnam rtog rtog dang bral bas na//de ni bstan du mi nus pa'o//rgyu dang 'bras bu med pa ste//
8b6(mdo): yod dang med kyis rnam par spangs//rdo ba phye mar btags pa la//gser ni yod par mi snang ste//spyad pa'i las kyi khyad par gyis//gser ni snang bar 'gyur ba yin//gzugs rnams rdul du 
8b7(mdo): rnam gzhigs te//mkhas pas phung po lhag ma dang //khams dang skye mched tshogs rnams dang //rnam par shes dang dbang po dag/gcig dang tha dad dngos po yang //rdul phran rnam par rab sbyangs na//
8b8(mdo): dngos por sangs rgyas yod pa min//sangs rgyas med pa'ang ma yin te//rnal 'byor can rnams sangs rgyas mthong //mtshan rab sum cu rtsa gnyis can//gang na sdug bsngal de na bde//de nyid 
9a1(mdo): @#//la ni snang ba yin//sangs rgyas med ces mi bya ste//sangs rgyas mnyam par bzhag pa yod//rgyu yi sangs rgyas dge ba can//rtsa ba mkhas pa nyid kyang ste//'jig rten 
9a2(mdo): kun gyi rgyal ba dang //yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang //'di dag sangs rgyas lngar gsungs so//sprul pa'i rgyal ba lhag ma rnams//de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yod//mtshan 
9a3(mdo): rab sum cu rtsa gnyis can//de bas sangs rgyas yod pa ste//rnal 'byor can gyi thub pas mthong //khams rnams gsum po 'das pa dang //rnam pa du mar sangs rgyas zhing //de bzhin 
9a4(mdo): gshegs kyi lha rdzas zhing //rgyal sras bzang pos kun tu gang //de na thub chen sangs rgyas bzhugs//mtshan gyis kun nas yongs su rgyas//rnal 'byor rnal la mnyam par bzhag 
9a5(mdo): chos dang bcas su rnam par mdzes//de bzhin phan tshun bsam gtan mdzad//shes rab ma shes shes byed la//stug po de na rnam par spyod//stug po de yi sems can su//
9a6(mdo): sangs rgyas gzugs can de dag kun//skad cig 'jig par shin tu 'das//ting nge 'dzin la rtag tu mos//dga' ldan nas babs 'phrul pa gang //rtog pa can rnams kun gyis 
9a7(mdo): mthong //stug po nas gshegs glang po ste//sangs rgyas gzugs ni stug na bzhugs//sna tshogs rnam mang gzugs tshul te//sems can bsam bzhin zhugs pa yis//
9a8(mdo): de bzhin gshegs pa mnyam bzhag pa//chu yi zla ba bzhin du snang //sna tshogs gzugs kyi nor bu ni//tshon gyi 'byor las rnam par mdzes//de bzhIn sangs rgyas stug 
9b1(mdo): zhing na//mnyam par bzhag pas rnam par mdzes//thams cad chos la gzugs brnyan ltar//gcig dang tha dad spangs par te//dgos pa kun la 'jug pa ni//skyes bu dam pa thams cad 
9b2(mdo): mkhyen//rdul las ma yin dus las min//dbang po las min gces las min//rkyen gyis ma yin 'jig rten dang //sangs rgyas ldan par rnam mdzes pa//rgyu yi tshul du sangs rgyas 
9b3(mdo): ni//'bras bu rnams la rnam par mdzes//'jig rten sku la 'khod bya ste//rgya mtsho ri dang shing dag dang //de la 'gro ba sna tshogs bcas//mnyam par bzhag pas shin tu dgyes//
9b4(mdo): bya ba thams cad phyi nang du//gza' zla la sogs mdzes pa'i rnams//phyir yang phyag gi mthil bkod de//yungs 'brur 'gro ba kun 'dzud pa//sangs rgyas thub pa'i rnal 'byor mnga'//
9b5(mdo): thub chen thub pa'i dam pa'o//'jig rten rnams la byed pa med//sangs rgyas 'phrul gyis sprul pa ste//'byung ba gsum po 'di dag kun//sangs rgyas 'od kyis rnam par sprul//rab rib 
9b6(mdo): mi shes myos mdongs pa'i//rtog pa can rnams 'phyan pa yin//bdag dang bdag med lta ba'i rnams//yod dang med pa'i smra bas bcom//'on tam thams cad 'jig pa dang //cung zad 
9b7(mdo): 'jig pas smra ba rnams//'di la med dam cung zad dam//bdag dang bdag med ga la yod//sangs rgyas sna tshogs 'byung kun na//rnal 'byor mkhan po rnam par mdzes//dri za'i grong la 
9b8(mdo): bya ba rnams//ji ltar snang ba 'jig rten na//rmi lam rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs//ri dgas rnams la smig rgyu bzhin//de bzhin 'jig rten sna tshogs dag/bde ga la sogs pa'i las 
10a1(mdo): @#//rnams kyang //rlung ldan sogs pa'i thag pa bzhin//sangs rgyas rnal 'byor mkhyen gyi mchog/mi la 'khrul 'khor skor ba ste//rgya mtsho'i skra ba 'dzin ba 'dra//stug po'i 
10a2(mdo): ris kyi ye shes kyi rgyan las byung zhes bya ba'i le'u ste dang po'o////de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur ba stan las langs te/bla gos phrag pa gcig la gzar nas pus 
10a3(mdo): mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/bcom ldan 'das shAkya thub pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar te phyag 
10a4(mdo): 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to//bcom ldan 'das mtshams med pa lnga bgyis pa rnams dang /dam pa'i chos spong ba rnams dang /'phags pa spong ba rnams 
10a5(mdo): dang /mnar med pa la gzhol ba rnams dang /ma dang pha la snying ring ba rnams dang /tshangs pa 'gums pa rnams dang /ba lang dang /dgum pa 'gums pa'i sems can rnams ji ltar yongs 
10a6(mdo): su 'grol bar 'gyur/bcom ldan 'das sems can de dag 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la ji ltar yongs su dgrol bar 'gyur/bcom ldana'adas kyis bka' stsal pa 'jam dpal sbyin 
10a7(mdo): ba gnyis byin pa'i sems can rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las yongs su 'grol bar 'gyur te/de 'di ltar chos kyi sbyin pa dang /zang zing gi sbyin pa'o//chos kyi sbyin pas ni skye ba dran 
10a8(mdo): par 'gyur ro//zang zing gi sbyin pas ni sems can thams cad la phan btags par 'gyur ro//zang zing ga sbyin pas ni bkres pa dang /skom pa'i sdug bsngal yongs su sbyong ngo//ches 
10b1(mdo): kyi sbyin pas ni sems can dmyal ba dang /byol song gi skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las yongs su 'grel to//'jam dpal sbyin pa gnyis po 'di byin na spyan 
10b2(mdo): pa thams cad 'dus par 'gyur ro//'jam dpal gzhan yang sbyin pa lngas sbyin pa dang nye ba'i sbyin pa thams cad 'dus par gyur te/lnga gang zhe na 'di lta ste/bzhon pa sbyin pa dang /gdugs sbyin pa 
10b3(mdo): dang /dar sbyin pa dang /gos sbyin pa dang /chos gos dang /bsod snyoms dang /mal cha dang /stan dang /nad kyi rkyen sman dang /yo byad sbyin pa rnams kyis sdug bsngal thams cad yongs su sbyangs 
10b4(mdo): par 'gyur ro//'jam dbal yang sems can pha la mtshams med pa lnga dag gam/dam pa'i chos spong ba dag gam/'phags pa spong ba dag gam/mnar med pa la gzhol ba dag gam/bskal 
10b5(mdo): par gnas pa dag gam/sems can gang la la dkon mchog gsum la snying ring ba 'am/sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la gnod par byed pa 'am/tshogs kyi nor la 'phrog pa dag gam 
10b6(mdo): chung ngun lug gsod pa dag kyang rung /phyag dar ba yang rung /sme sha can yang rung ste/'jam dpal sus shin tu rgyas pa chen po rmad du byung ba'i chos stug po'i rgyan rin po che 'di thos 
10b7(mdo): pa dang /'dri ba dang /'drir 'jug pa dang /'dzin pa dang /klog pa dang /kun chub par byed pa dang /gzhan la yang rgya cher yang dag par ston pa dang /chung ngun yi ge gcig kyang rung 
10b8(mdo): ste rjod pa dang /su'ang chos de smra ba la mchod cing rim gro byed pa dang /nang par langs nas ngo phrad par byed cing lta bar sngar smra ba sbyin par byed pa dang /lag pas reg par byed pa'i sems 
11a1(mdo): @#//can de dag thams cad 'jam dpal sems can dmyal ba dang /byol song gi skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su 'grol bar 'gyur 
11a2(mdo): ro//'jam dpal sa'i phyogs gang na chos smra ba 'dug gam/de'i dur ram/ro'am/ro bam pa zhig yod la/de'i ngo mthong na yang mtshams med pa'i las lnga rnams byang bar 'gyur ro//'jam 
11a3(mdo): dpal rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na yi dwags lto dpag tshad brgya stong du mar skyes pa yod de/yi dwags de bdag gi las kyi sdug bsngal mi bzad pa'i tshor ba yod do//'jam dpal de bzhin du sems 
11a4(mdo): can su mdo sde chen po rin po che 'di spong ba de dag kyang sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ro//'jam dpal sus mdo sde rin po che 'di rim gror byas te/me tog dang /bdug spos dang /mar me dang 
11a5(mdo): spos dang /phreng ba dang /byug pa dang /phye ma dang /chos gos dang /gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang /lha'i ba dan gyis mchod pa dang /chos smra ba de yang mchod par bya ste/ji ste chos smra 
11a6(mdo): ba de mtshams med pa lnga byed na yang 'on kyang de'i sems 'khrugs par mi bya'o//chung dun byol yong gi skye gnas su gtogs pa'i ri dgas dang /bya gang la las chos smra ba de shi ba'i ro bam bdur 
11a7(mdo): khro dan 'dug pa'i sha zos kyang de dag thams cad phyir mi ldog par 'gyur te bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyang 'thob par 'gyur ro//ri dgas dang bya gzhan po de dag thams cad 
11a8(mdo): sangs rgyas kyi zhing stug po 'di nyid du 'thob par 'gyur te/de la nem nur dang /the tsom dang yid gnyis mi bya'o//sems can gang la la sdod dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/sngon byang chub sems 
11b1(mdo): dpas yongs su bzung ba/sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i sa bon las yongs su ma nyams pa de dag thams cad phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus na mdo sde rin po che 'di thos par 'gyur ro//thos nas kyang mchod pa chen pos mchod 
11b2(mdo): par 'gyur ro//mdo sde thams cad 'dus pa'i rgyan stug po rin po che las sbyin pa'i le'u ste gnyis so////mtha' yas yul can shin tu phra//bsam gtan mkhyen pa skyes bu'i mchog 
11b3(mdo): dbang po 'das pa mngon sum pa//chags dang dbang po rnam par spangs//bsam gtan bsam pa bsam gtan pa'i//de ni dgos pa'i tshul yin te//thub pa rnal 'byor mkhas pa'i rnams//kun 
11b4(mdo): gyi snying la gnas pa yin//yod dang med kyi phyogs dang bral//sangs rgyas phyogs ni dri ma med//blo dang shes bya bral ba ste//tshad dang dbang po spangs pa yin//sems shes rnams kyi yul ma yin//
11b5(mdo): de ni grol ba rnams kyi yul//mtshan rnams kun kyang snang ba ste//de bzhin gshegs ni mtshan med pa'ang //dregs can rnams kyi dregs med mdzad//mnyam par bzhag cing gos pa med//
11b6(mdo): g.yo ba ma yin g.yo med min//chags med lam la gnas pa ste//lha yul byung ba'i lha rnams dang //dri za lha min mi 'am ci//thub pa rnams dang mur 'dug gis//bstod kyang rtag tu yang mi 
11b7(mdo): g.yo//de la ngo mtshar sred pa med//'gro ba gang na'ang g.yo ba med//sngon nas dag pa'i rnal 'byor gyi//de ni pha rol yin pa'i phyir//sangs rgyas 'phrul pa'i spyod pa yis//bya ba tsam du lta rnams 
11b8(mdo): kyis//mthong yang de dang 'di na med//ji bzhin nyi zla de dang 'dra//rnal 'byor yul du gnas pa ni//dregs pa med mdzad 'gro bas mthong //rnam pa tha dad mur 'dug rnams//gang la gang gis 
12a1(mdo): dbang gyur pa//de la de lta'i chos ston te//rnal 'byor bskyed pa'i 'od zer gyis//rnal 'byor chos can rnam phye zhing //rgyal po'i chos dang gsum po dag/rgyal po'am rgyal po'i 
12a2(mdo): 'khor rnams dang //rgyal po'i yul gyi bya ba dang //dka' thub tshul dang zhing rnams kyi//phun sum tshogs pa de las byung //lha rdzas rnams dang nam mkha' dang //rin chen 'byung khung rnam dag pa//
12a3(mdo): lha yi lha yi mthu yis na//phyogs dang yul na 'bar ba yin//'byung ba gsum gyi thabs rnams gang //rnam pa sna tshogs mkhas rnams kyis//gang rnams byed pa zhug bya ba dag/sangs rgyas 
12a4(mdo): lhun gyis grub 'bras bu//de ni mdo 'dzin 'gro ba yi//dgos dang dka' thub can rig dang //gad mo rtse ba'i sbyor ba dang //gar mkhan rnams la rtag tu'o//dga' ldan gnas babs 
12a5(mdo): 'jig rten gyis//mthong ba bud med 'gro dang bcas//'phrog cing sbyin dang 'brel ba dang //cod pan can dang lag na gzhur//dam pa rnams kyis kun tu mthong //stug po nas ni de ma 
12a6(mdo): bral//yul 'di thub pa de yis te//thams cad na'ang shin tu snang //rab rib can gyi rab rib bzhin//ri dwags rnams kyi smig rgyu 'dra//'jig rten rnams kyi sgyu ma la//ji ltar gzhan du 
12a7(mdo): mthong ba dang //rmi lam na yang gzhan du ba'i//rmi lam bzhin du bus pas mthong //khyad par rab tu mthong ba ni//rnal 'byor can rnams log yong bzhin//lha mi lha yi yul yin te//
12a8(mdo): de yi sras kyi dus kun du//mi sbyin gu lang tshangs pa dang //sa nan ta dang sa nan 'da'//sa nan gzhon nu ser skya dang //ne tso la sogs rnams bsams kyang //de yi yul la rnam par bslangs 
12b1(mdo): de dag rnal 'byor gyis mi mthong //thub pa gang dag 'byung ba dang //byung dang da ltar gang 'khod pa//de dag yul ni gang yang min//lta ba'i bag chags g.yogs pa'i phyir//sa dang sar ni rnam 
12b2(mdo): spyod pa'i//rdo rje'i snying po de la bstan//lha yi lhas ni byas pa yi//stug po'i zhing na yod pa yis//'di dag rdo rje'i snying po de//mnyam par bzhag la shin tu bstan//rnal 'byor can gyis

12b4(mdo): skye ba dag ni chos tsam ste//ldog par 'gyur ba'ang chos tsam mo//kun du phra ba'i bdag nyid kyi//yon tan dag tu dngos yod brtags//mar me bzhin du gsal byed pa//rgyu rnams dgos 
12b5(mdo): pa grub pa dag/mtshan nyid snga nas mi rnyed de//'jig dang bral bas mi gnas pa'o//'das pa 'das pa'i dngos por yang //yod pa ma yin 'byung ba med//rkyen du bya rnams med par yang //
12b6(mdo): brtag pa'i dngos po gang yang med//rkyen rnams yin te 'dus pa la//dngos po yod pa ma yin te//rkyen rnams gang gi rkyen du 'gyur//yod dang med pa'i dngos mi snang //med pa'ang snang ba yod 
12b7(mdo): ma yin//phra ba'i bdag gis rnam par brtags//phung po rdza ma ras la sogs//ri dwags skom gdungs smig rgyu bzhin//rmi lam dri za 'dra ba ste//gtsug lag nor ba drug dang bcas//rab 
12b8(mdo): tu smra ba sum brgya yis//'jug pa dag dang snang ba yin//mkhas pas rmi lam gang mthong ba//skye ba med cing 'chi med par//slar sad nas su sems pa ni//bu mo mkhas pa dag yin no//
13a1(mdo): ji ltar 'dod de rnams kyi//grib ma kun tu snang ba bzhin//de ltar 'jig rten rmi lam yang //mkhas pa rnams ni de bzhin bsam//ji ltar skyes bu nyal ba zhig/bud med 
13a2(mdo): lhan cig rtse dga' rmi//sna tshogs yid du 'ong ba dang //lha rab btsun mo mnyam pa dang //gzhan yang sna tshogs dngos po de//sad nas rnam par sems pa ni//ci zhig bden nam rmi lam yin//
13a3(mdo): rmi lam bud med lhan cig tu//rtses nas phyir ni bdag sad te//'di brdzun bus bslu ba yin//de bzhin bdag gi gnyen pa kun//rgyal srid stobs kyang de bzhin no//mag pa gyos po bu dag 
13a4(mdo): dang //ma dang phu nu po dag kyang //rmi lam lta bur rig bya ste//rnal 'byor sbyar bar cis mi bya//dka' thub tshal dang zhing rnams dang //ri dang ri'i sman gshong dang //'o ma 'byung dang ma la ya//
13a5(mdo): lhun po byin dang dbang chen dang //gangs kyi ri dang ke la sa//char 'bab dag la'ang gang gnas dang //'dzam bu 'bras bu'i khu ba dang //gang dag bdud rtsi za ba dang //phan du kam pal bar ya

13a7(mdo): cad kyi ni rnal 'byor 'di//gang 'byung 'byung ba rnams kyi ste//pad mo gnas su brten bcas te//skyil mo krung du mnyam bzhag cing //rtag tu rnal 'byor sbyar bar gyis//'dod dang bde las 
13a8(mdo): rnam par dben//dbang po dbang po'i don gyis rnams//thams cad las kyang phyir zlog cing //lcags lus glang po ji bzhin du//sems ni mnyam par bzhag par gyis//'jig rten 
13b1(mdo): 'jig rten 'das bsam gtan//gang yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge/'dod dang dga' ba dben la sogs//yang na thams cad bsgrags pa dang //khyad par du'ang gzugs med dang //'du shes 
13b2(mdo): med pa'i bsam gtan rnams//nam mkha' rnam shes mtha' yas dang //'du shes yod min med min rnams//nyi ma dang ni zla ba'i dbyibs//pad mo dang ni 'od 'dra zhing //nam mkha' ri mo me 'dra 
13b3(mdo): bar//rnal 'byor zhugs pas rab tu mthong //'di dag thams cad spangs nas su//snang ba med par rab tu gnas//gang tshe mtshan med rnal 'byor can//rnam par mi rtag chags med na//sangs 
13b4(mdo): rgyas bye ba rnams kyang mthong //zhing dang zhing na mnyam bzhag pa//de dag phyag gi dbang bskur bar//de yi spyi bor dbang bskur te//sangs rgyas sa la bzhugs pa dang //sna tshogs gzugs ni rab tu
